yAxisTitleLocation.description:
The location of an individual y axis title in the y axis fields.
it can be 'end': which will be placed at the top; and 'middle': which will appear at the center.
This property overrides the nameLocation property in the yAxis object.

yAxisTitleRotation.description:
The rotation of an individual y axis title in the y axis fields.
It accepts negative values. You can rotate the title -90 degrees.
This property overrides the nameRotate property in the yAxis object.

yAxisTitleGap.description:
The name gap of an individual y axis title in the y axis fields.
this property overrides the nameGap property in the yAxis object.

title: Configuration for Y Axis title overrides. These values will override the values in yAxis and will be applied on each of the yAxis fields.
name: UiSdlLineBarChartYAxisConfigOverride
